title: 第25章 刘傲菲出事第26章 强势救出
slug: 分手后我聘上女同学妈妈小司机
content_zh:
钟知夏再也抑制不住内心的激动，不顾周围食客的目光，“噗通”一声跪倒在地上。
对着陈阳恭恭敬敬地磕了个头：“弟子钟知夏，今日就拜你为师！多谢师父！”
她这突如其来的举动，瞬间吸引了烧烤店内所有食客的目光。
老板和服务员也都好奇地看了过来，眼神里满是疑惑。
好好吃着烧烤，怎么突然就拜师了？
陈阳也没想到她这么激动，连忙起身将她扶起来：“起来吧，不用这么大阵仗。”
钟知夏站起身，脸颊因激动而泛红，眼神里满是欣喜和坚定：“师父，从现在起，你就是我的师父了！”
“嗯，没问题。”陈阳点了点头，重新坐回座位。
钟知夏也坐了下来，心情依旧十分激动。
她拿起一只刚烤好的大虾，小心翼翼地剥去虾壳，递到陈阳面前，柔声说：“师父，你多吃点。”
说完，又拿起几串烤得焦香的烤肉，放到陈阳的盘子里。
“你也多吃点，徒弟。”陈阳笑着说，也给她夹了几串烤串。
钟知夏吃得满心欢喜，又忍不住问：“师父，那你什么时候开始传我医术？我已经迫不及待想学习了！”
“先不急。”陈阳摆了摆手，“要先看你的表现。
等你表现好了，我自然会传你。”
他心里暗自思忖：自己的治疗神通是七仙女传承的核心，自然不能外传。
但传承中还有很多厉害的医术功法，这些功法足够钟知夏学一辈子了，到时传授给她也无妨。
“好！我一定好好表现！”钟知夏立刻保证，眼神坚定，“师父，那你接下来要我做什么？”
“你先帮我多介绍些患者，其他的事情回头再说。”陈阳说。
“没问题！包在我身上！”钟知夏拍着胸脯答应下来。

就在这时，陈阳的手机突然响了起来，屏幕上显示着“刘冰冰”的名字。
他拿起手机接通：“喂，冰冰。”
电话那头传来刘冰冰带着焦急声音：“陈阳，我妈还没有回来，她的电话也打不通，我好担心她……”
陈阳的神色瞬间变得严肃起来，安慰道：“别担心，她可能是公司有事在忙，我给她打个电话问一下。”
“好……”刘冰冰的声音依旧带着担忧。
挂了刘冰冰的电话，陈阳立刻拨通了刘傲菲的号码。
可电话里却传来了“您所拨打的用户已关机”的提示音。
他眉头微微皱起，心中也泛起了一丝疑惑。
刘傲菲怎么这么晚还没回家？
而且手机还关机！
“师父，怎么了？”钟知夏察觉到他神色不对，连忙问。
“有点急事，我得先走了。”陈阳站起身，对着钟知夏说：“宵夜我来结账，你慢慢吃。”
不等钟知夏回应，陈阳就扫码付钱，快步走出了烧烤店。
另边，凤鸣居。
刘冰冰正站在别墅里焦急地来回踱步。
听到熟悉的汽车引擎声，她立刻朝着门口冲了出去。
看到陈阳从车上下来，她快步跑到陈阳面前，眼眶通红，声音带着颤抖：“陈阳，我妈手机从来不会关机的……
她会不会真出事了？”
陈阳看着她焦急无助的样子，连忙安慰道：“冰冰，你妈应该没事的，你先冷静下，一切有我呢。”
陈阳想了下，问：“你妈平时晚上可能会去哪些地方？比如公司加班、见客户，或者去朋友家？”

刘冰冰用力摇了摇头，泪水在眼眶里打转：“我不知道……我刚才已经给她公司的李秘书打过电话了，李秘书说我妈加班到八九点钟就自己开车走了，没说要去其他地方。”
content_en:
Zhong Zhixia could no longer suppress her inner excitement and fell to her knees with a "pop" regardless of the gazes of the surrounding diners.
He kowtowed respectfully to Chen Yang: "Disciple Zhong Zhixia, I will accept you as my master today! Thank you so much, Master!"
Her sudden move instantly attracted the attention of all the diners in the barbecue restaurant.
The boss and the waiter also looked over curiously, with doubts in their eyes.
You were enjoying your barbecue, why did you suddenly become a disciple?
Chen Yang didn't expect her to be so excited, so he quickly stood up and helped her up: "Get up, there's no need for such a big fight."
Zhong Zhixia stood up, her cheeks flushed with excitement, her eyes full of joy and determination: "Master, from now on, you are my master!"
"Yeah, no problem." Chen Yang nodded and sat back in his seat.
Zhong Zhixia also sat down, still very excited.
She picked up a freshly grilled prawn, carefully peeled off the shell, handed it to Chen Yang, and said softly: "Master, eat more."
After saying that, he picked up a few skewers of roasted meat and put them on Chen Yang's plate.
"You should also eat more, apprentice." Chen Yang said with a smile, and also gave her a few skewers.
Zhong Zhixia ate with great joy, but couldn't help but ask: "Master, when will you start teaching me medical skills? I can't wait to learn!"
"There's no rush yet." Chen Yang waved his hand, "We need to see your performance first.
When you perform well, I will naturally pass you on. "
He secretly thought to himself: His magical healing power is the core of the inheritance of the Seven Fairies, so naturally it cannot be passed on to others.
But there are many powerful medical skills in the inheritance. These skills are enough for Zhong Zhixia to learn for a lifetime, and there is no harm in teaching them to her when the time comes.
"Okay! I will perform well!" Zhong Zhixia promised immediately, with firm eyes, "Master, what do you want me to do next?"
"You can help me introduce more patients first, and we'll talk about other things later." Chen Yang said.
"No problem! Keep it with me!" Zhong Zhixia agreed, patting her chest.
At this moment, Chen Yang's cell phone suddenly rang, and the name "Liu Bingbing" was displayed on the screen.
He picked up the phone and connected: "Hello, Bingbing."
Liu Bingbing's anxious voice came from the other end of the phone: "Chen Yang, my mother hasn't come back yet, and her phone can't be reached. I'm so worried about her..."
Chen Yang's expression instantly became serious, and he comforted her: "Don't worry, she may be busy with something in the company, I'll give her a call and ask."
"Okay..." Liu Bingbing's voice was still worried.
After hanging up the phone from Liu Bingbing, Chen Yang immediately dialed Liu Aofei's number.
But there was a prompt tone on the phone saying "The user you dialed has turned off his phone".
He frowned slightly, and there was a trace of doubt in his heart.
Why hasn't Liu Aofei gone home so late?
And the phone is turned off!
"Master, what's wrong?" Zhong Zhixia noticed something was wrong with his expression and asked quickly.
"It's a bit urgent. I have to leave first." Chen Yang stood up and said to Zhong Zhixia, "I'll pay for the late night snack. You eat slowly."
Without waiting for Zhong Zhixia's response, Chen Yang scanned the QR code to pay and quickly walked out of the barbecue restaurant.
On the other side, Fengmingju.
Liu Bingbing was standing in the villa, pacing back and forth anxiously.
Hearing the familiar sound of a car engine, she immediately rushed towards the door.
Seeing Chen Yang get out of the car, she quickly ran to Chen Yang, her eyes red and her voice trembling: "Chen Yang, my mother's phone is never turned off...
Could something really happen to her? "
Chen Yang looked at her anxious and helpless look and quickly comforted her: "Bingbing, your mother should be fine. Just calm down first. I'll take care of everything."
Chen Yang thought for a moment and asked, "Where might your mother go at night? For example, working overtime at the company, meeting clients, or going to a friend's house?"
Liu Bingbing shook her head vigorously, tears welling up in her eyes: "I don't know... I justI have already called Secretary Li in her company. Secretary Li said that my mother worked overtime until eight or nine o'clock and drove away by herself. She didn't say she was going anywhere else. "
